title: Turn on GitHub's merge queue for main (owner setting)
problem: What merges is rarely exactly what was tested: a PR head is a median 1 (p90 5) commits behind main when it merges, and only 34% are on the tip. With conflicts now rare (20% tax) a batching merge queue is cheap and closes that gap (docs/parallel-agents.md fix 4).
evidence: 924 PRs merged 2026-10-17..10-20T06:00: commits on main between the PR's merge-base and its merge: median 1, p75 3, p90 5; 310 at 0
change: Owner: enable the merge queue on main in branch protection, with batching (e.g. up to 5) and the required checks that already run on PRs. Agents then: add `merge_group:` to the triggers of each required workflow, and switch land-your-work.md step 5 from 'squash-merge' to 'enable auto-merge / add to the queue'. Do this after P037-P039 so CI tells the truth first.
metric: share of merged PRs whose tested head was not the tip of main at merge
